BiblicalUsage: Chezqah is prevailing power, the strength that holds its ground, and the histories use it of kings who grow strong. Rehoboam strengthens himself when his kingdom is established, Uzziah is strengthened until his heart is lifted up, Isaiah is told to speak with a strong hand, and Daniel foresees a king who will stir up all against the realm of Grecia.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe strength that forgets God turns to pride, and that is the warning written into this word. I hold that prevailing power is only safe in a hand that stays humble.
